title: ECL outcome-reason extension value v1
description: The value of ecl.ext.outcome-reason.v1: the registered primary reason of a terminal execution outcome (TRANSACTIONAL-EFFECT-1 outcome evidence table). It carries no free text. A cancelled attempt of an MCP gateway whose wall clock regressed between its first check and its final observation carries ecl.error.clock-regressed.v1 (MG1-014).
